name: Advance Payment of Benefit
description: A financial assistance product that advances benefit payments to eligible clients to meet immediate and essential needs across a range of specified categories, subject to qualification, income, asset, and hardship obligation requirements.

attributes.summary: A financial assistance product that advances benefit payments to eligible clients to meet immediate and essential needs across a range of specified categories, subject to qualification, income, asset, and hardship obligation requirements.
attributes.eligibility: Income limits, cash asset limits, immediate and essential needs assessment, existing debt level consideration
attributes.payment_details: Covers payment categories including ambulance subscription fees, appliances and furniture, assignment/subletting/ending tenancy, funeral attendance, bedding, beds/chairs/tables, car repairs, child restraints and safety helmets, clothing, dental treatment, dentures and hearing aids, electricity/gas/water, essential home repairs, fire loss or burglary, fridges/freezers/washing machines, glasses, laser therapy for birthmark removal, safety footwear, school costs, telephone installation, Tenancy Tribunal fees, and travel for stranded clients. Preferred supplier arrangements available for fridges/freezers/washing machines and glasses.
attributes.obligations: Reasonable steps obligation, budgeting activity obligation, attending a budgeting course or seminar, attending a budgeting advice service
attributes.income_test: Income limits apply as qualification criteria
